case_number: 2025 INSC 161; CIVIL APPEAL NO. ……………. OF 2025 (Arising out of S.L.P.(C) No.30398 of 2019)

parties.respondent: The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd. and Others

summary: Motor accident compensation; split multiplier method rejected; pre-retirement/post-retirement bifurcation improper without specific reasons; Sarla Verma and Sumathi principles reaffirmed; future prospects entitlement; compensation reduction by High Court set aside; Tribunal award restored with 15% increase for future prospects and inclusion of loss of estate, funeral expense, consortium.
legal_provisions_cited: National Insurance Company Limited v. Pranay Sethi and Others
Sumathi v. M/s. National Insurance Company Ltd.
Puttamma & Ors. v. K. L. Narayana Reddy & Anr.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; compensation as awarded by Tribunal restored with 15% increase for future prospects and addition of loss of estate, revised funeral expenses, and consortium.
